TITLE: Space partitioning within groups of social coral reef fish
REGION: Eilat, northern Gulf of Aqaba, Red Sea, Israel
DATA: Own in situ 3-GoPro stereo video around home corals, 4 tagged groups, 15 runs (2015, 2017)

ARCH: Faster R-CNN Inception V2 detector + frame-to-frame linking, manual ambiguity resolution, DLT 3D reconstruction
METR: Detection rate (% of time outside coral detected) per fish/run; ecological metrics (foraging volume, overlap, shading)
